title: Marcos, Liza take time off to recharge
summary: After hurdling hectic schedules before and during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summits, President Marcos took two days off to recharge and bond…

blocks.text: In her Facebook account, Liza uploaded a photo of her and the President in plain clothes spending some quiet time together in Baguio City.

MANILA, Philippines — After hurdling hectic schedules before and during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summits, President Marcos took two days off to recharge and bond with First Lady Liza Marcos.
“After a whirlwind of activities these past few weeks, we finally decided to take Sunday and Monday off to slow down, rest and recharge,” the First Lady said in a post published yesterday.
“No big plans, no fuss… just a little peace and quiet and some much-needed downtime together. And so far, we’re loving it!”
Marcos hosted the ASEAN Leaders Summit from Nov. 15 to 17 and welcomed US President Donald Trump at Malacañang on Nov. 18.
He flew to China to participate in the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders Meeting on the same day and returned to the Philippines last Friday.
Marcos previously said his participation at APEC – his 48th foreign trip since becoming President in 2022 – yielded “concrete” results for the Filipinos.
He said his business meetings in China generated P41.1 billion in investment pledges across various sectors that may create more than 7,000 jobs.
